## Keywords

{{< glossary digital-media digitization raster-image vector-graphics elemental-tetrad mechanics aesthetics player-experience asset production-pipeline >}}

## Think · What does the player meet first?

You open a new game for the first time.
**Do you meet its code, or something else?**

::: {.answer}
Its **media**: pictures, music, sounds, text, video.
:::

## 1.1 Digital media

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="38%"}
- text · images · audio
- video · animation · interactive
- stored as **numbers**
- games **compress** them
:::
::: {.column width="62%"}
![](images/sampling.png)
:::
::::

## Raster or vector?

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="38%"}
- raster: pixels (photos, paintings)
- vector: shapes (logos, icons)
- **Do it together:** Paint vs PowerPoint, zoom in
:::
::: {.column width="62%"}
![](images/raster-vector.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 1 · Media as numbers

a) a logo for an icon and a poster?
b) a painted forest background?
c) measuring a sound wave many times?

::: {.answer}
a) vector
b) raster
c) digitization
:::

## 1.2 What makes game media special

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="38%"}
- **modularity**: reusable parts
- **variability**: many versions
- **interactivity**: it answers the player
- **Do it together:** listen for changes in a game
:::
::: {.column width="62%"}
![](images/music-layers.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 2 · Which feature?

a) the same tiles again and again?
b) drums added when an enemy is near?
c) a sound every time the player jumps?

::: {.answer}
a) modularity
b) variability
c) interactivity
:::

## 1.3 The elemental tetrad

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="38%"}
- mechanics · story
- aesthetics · technology
- all equal
- goal: **player experience**
:::
::: {.column width="62%"}
![](images/tetrad.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 3 · The tetrad of Lantern Keeper

a) tap to float; fireflies grow the light
b) warm light, soft piano
c) simple light effect, 60 fps on old phones

::: {.answer}
a) mechanics
b) aesthetics
c) technology
:::

## 1.4 The production pipeline

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="38%"}
- pre-production: plan
- production: make assets
- post-production: finish
- testing sends work back
- **Do it together:** a coin icon in three stages
:::
::: {.column width="62%"}
![](images/pipeline.png)
:::
::::

## Example · One sound through the pipeline

The firefly chime of Lantern Keeper.

::: {.reveal}
1. plan: "soft, bright, under half a second"
2. record a bell 3 times
3. cut, match loudness, save as Ogg
4. test: too loud → back to mixing
:::

## Try it 4 · Which stage?

a) writing the script
b) recording a voice
c) exporting the trailer

::: {.answer}
a) pre-production
b) production
c) post-production
:::

## Game challenge · Lantern Keeper's media plan

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}
- 2-minute music loop, 3 layers
- firefly chime × 3 versions
- logo · painted background
- 30-second trailer
:::
::: {.column width="45%"}
![](images/lantern-keeper.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 5 · Planning the media (harder)

a) 3 music layers: which feature?
b) why 3 versions of the chime?
c) logo for icon and banner?

::: {.answer}
a) variability
b) so it does not repeat exactly
c) vector
:::

## Summary

- digital media = numbers · compressed
- raster = pixels · vector = shapes
- game media change with play
- tetrad → player experience
- pre-production → production → post-production → testing
